不要说 'The network has a delay.'，虽然能懂，但地道说法是 'The ping is too high' 或 'It's lagging'。
不要说 'My game always stops.'，地道表达卡顿用 'freezing' 或 'stuttering'。
talk_game_steam_refund.ai: Alex 是你的房东，他关心你的居住体验，并建议你检查一下路由器或者更换一个时间段玩。
talk_game_steam_refund.task: 向房东描述游戏卡顿（lag）的情况。

tgt: Hi, I'm going to be away for a couple of days. Could you do me a favor?
Would you mind taking a package for me if it arrives tomorrow?
I'd really appreciate it if that's not too much trouble.
traps: 错用“Please keep my package”：显得把任务强加给对方。用“Would you mind...”来询问对方的意愿。
错用“You must help me”：语气带有强迫感。使用“If that's not too much trouble”给予对方回绝的空间。
错用“I give you my package”：含义模糊。应明确说是“taking/receiving a package”。
soc_favor_neighbor_package.ai: 你是邻居，平时关系不错，很爽快地答应了，告诉你随时敲门就行。
soc_favor_neighbor_package.task: 礼貌请求邻居帮忙代收包裹

tgt: Noah, pushing your cousin is not acceptable, and you need to apologize to him right now.
It is normal to want to keep your favorite car, but sharing makes playtime much more fun for everyone.
How about you two take turns driving the remote control car for ten minutes each?
traps: “这样做是不对的”常错用 doing this is wrong，地道说法是 is not acceptable 或 is not nice。
“轮流做某事”地道固定搭配是 take turns doing something，如果说 do by turns 则是中国式英语。
“每个人”如果用 every people 属于严重语法错误，必须用 everyone。
soc_parent_sharing_toys.ai: Alex 扮演儿子 Noah，觉得那是自己最爱的玩具，别人碰一下都会抢走，委屈地护住赛车。
soc_parent_sharing_toys.task: 让孩子意识到推人是不对的，并引导他学会把玩具轮流和表弟玩

tgt: Hey, are you trying to learn Chinese from this show?
That word means 'it's complicated' in a romantic context.
I'm actually looking for someone to practice my English with. Maybe we could grab a protein shake after?
traps: 说 'You want to study Chinese with me?' 语气太像在布置作业。用 'Maybe we could practice together' 更自然。
说 'What is the meaning of that word?' 太正式且僵硬。用 'What does that word mean?' 即可。
说 'I teach you, you teach me' 语法不完整。说 'I'd be happy to help you with your Chinese if you'd help me with my English' 更地道。
hob_lang_gym_chat.ai: Alex 是个健身达人，对中文感兴趣但只会一点基础短语。他想问你电视里的那个词是什么意思。
hob_lang_gym_chat.task: 告诉他那个词的意思，并提议两人可以互相练习语言。

tgt: The speakers at these free seminars usually just try to scare seniors into buying overpriced products.
If it were a real medicine, it would be sold at a pharmacy with a prescription, not at a community center.
Let's go down to the store together tomorrow to get a full refund; we can buy some real fish from the market instead.
traps: 误用 'You were cheated' 直接指责老人被骗，会激起防备心。地道说法是 'Those seminars are known for taking advantage of seniors'。
直译 'This is fake' 缺乏依据。描述保健品夸大宣传应用 'They make exaggerated claims to sell overpriced supplements'。
用 'give me the money back' 要退款太粗鲁。温和交涉应用 'request a full refund'。
soc_elder_health_supplement.ai: Alex 扮演你的父亲。他觉得推销员态度很好、送了东西，而且同小区的张大爷也在吃，坚信这药效显著，反过来嫌你管得宽。
soc_elder_health_supplement.task: 用温和且有说服力的方式让父亲明白这是营销套路，并陪他去退掉这笔消费。

tgt: Thanks for checking, but today isn't a good time for me.
Could you give me at least 24 hours' notice before coming over?
We can schedule something for next week if it's really necessary.
traps: 使用 'My room is too dirty, you cannot come' 会把重点放在房间卫生上，反而落了下风，应该强调个人隐私和预约机制。
使用 'You need my permission to enter' 语气过于具有对抗性和法律威胁感，用 'today isn't a good time' 加 '24 hours' notice' 更有契约精神。
使用 'I am resting now so go away' 极其粗暴，地道的英文表述要保持客气但立场坚定。
soc_bound_landlord_entry.ai: Alex 是你的房东，他出于对房子的关心想顺便查看，他会强调这花不了几分钟，也不会打扰你太久。
soc_bound_landlord_entry.task: 拒绝房东未经预约的临时造访，要求改期

tgt: Dave, here is my locker key, and today is my last swim here.
I'm moving across town, so I won't be coming back to this pool.
Thanks for keeping an eye on my water bottle all these months!
traps: 说成 'give you the key back' 不够简洁，用 'returning my key' 或 'here is my key'。
说 'look at my water bottle' 意思是盯着看，帮人留意或照看东西要说 'keeping an eye on'。
说 'change to another place' 表达搬家很别扭，地道表达是 'moving across town'。
soc_farewell_gym_frontdesk.ai: Dave 把 10 美元押金退给你，笑着跟你击掌，说欢迎你以后回社区时随时来游泳。
soc_farewell_gym_frontdesk.task: 拿回 10 美元钥匙押金并向 Dave 道别

tgt: The view from my balcony is absolutely breathtaking.
I just had a delicious lunch that cost me about 15 dollars.
I'm really enjoying the relaxed pace of life here.
traps: 说成 'The view is very beautiful'。虽然没错，但 'breathtaking' 或 'stunning' 更地道。
说成 'I ate a lunch of 15 dollars'。应该说 'a 15-dollar lunch'，用连字符作形容词。
说成 'I am enjoying the life here'。应该说 'the pace of life'，表示节奏或生活方式。
soc_family_vacation_update.ai: 你的父母，对你的生活充满好奇，会询问你的心情和接下来的行程安排。
soc_family_vacation_update.task: 描述酒店阳台的景色和那顿午餐的口感。

tgt: Can you believe they've hiked the prices again?
It feels like we're paying more for less these days.
I'm really starting to reconsider my daily coffee habit.
traps: 不要说 'The price is up'，不够地道。用 'The prices have been hiked' 或 'It's gotten so pricey'。
不要说 'I don't have enough money'，太直接露骨。用 'It's starting to stretch my budget'。
不要说 'The quality is low'，这显得很挑剔。应说 'The value for money has really dropped'。
talk_money_coffee_inflation.ai: 一名住在附近的当地白领，他非常健谈，正在抱怨最近即使是外食也变得难以负担。
talk_money_coffee_inflation.task: 与对方交流对通胀的看法，并顺带表达对这杯咖啡性价比的怀疑。

tgt: His style is recognizable instantly, even if it follows a similar formula lately.
Nothing beats the emotional impact of that main theme in the battle scene.
You have to admit the brass section in this track gives you goosebumps.
traps: 说成 'His style can be recognized immediately.'。被动语态显得死板，地道口语常用主动表达 'His style is recognizable instantly.'。
说成 'No music can beat this.'。表达某事物无可匹敌，地道说法是 'Nothing beats...'。
说成 'This song makes my skin have bumps.'。鸡皮疙瘩的中式直译错误，地道表达是 'gives you goosebumps'。
talk_movie_park_soundtrack_chat.ai: Alex，路过的古典乐迷。他高度评价这位作曲家的管弦乐编排，但认为他最近几年的作品越来越模式化、缺乏新意。
talk_movie_park_soundtrack_chat.task: 与对方交流对这位作曲家新旧作品的看法，坚持认为经典永不过时

tgt: The machine suddenly crashed and rebooted right after I inserted 4 tokens.
It swallowed my tokens without starting the game session.
Could you open the coin slot to retrieve them or give me replacement tokens?
traps: 描述机器死机时表达不地道：不宜说 'The machine is dead.'，地道说法应用 'The machine suddenly crashed and rebooted.'。
描述吞币时直译：不宜说 'The machine ate my money.'，地道说法应用 'It swallowed my tokens.'。
要求补偿时用词生硬：不宜说 'Give me new tokens.'，地道说法应用 'Could you give me replacement tokens?'。
talk_game_claw_machine.ai: Alex 是巡场维护人员，他会拿着钥匙过来查看机器状况，并核对你的投币数量以便人工补偿。
talk_game_claw_machine.task: 向工作人员说明机器吞币和黑屏的经过，并请他帮忙取出代币或退款

tgt: It is such an honor to be part of your special day.
May your life together be filled with laughter and love.
Let’s raise a glass to the happy couple—to love!
traps: 说成'I wish you have a happy life'，语法错误，应该用'I wish you a happy life'。
说成'You guys are very match'，搭配错误，'match'在这里是名词，形容词应用'well-matched'或'a perfect match'。
说成'Congratulation'，习惯用法应使用复数'Congratulations'。
soc_congrats_wedding_toast.ai: 司仪。他非常热情，期待你讲一段动人且幽默的短语，他希望你不要讲太久，以免耽误晚宴上菜。
soc_congrats_wedding_toast.task: 在不尴尬的情况下，用简洁的英文表达祝福并带动现场气氛。

tgt: Excuse me, I bought this whole wheat bread this morning, but it's past the best-before date.
Look here, there's actually some mold on the edge.
I'd like to exchange it for a fresh loaf, please.
traps: 说成 'This bread is overdue.'，'overdue' 通常指图书馆书籍或账单逾期，食品过期用 'past the best-before date' 或 'expired'。
说成 'It has bad thing on it.'，词汇极度贫乏，地道说法是 'There is some mold on it.'
说成 'Change a new one for me.'，中式语法直译，地道说法是 'I'd like to exchange it for a fresh loaf.'
life_food_bakery_expired_bread.ai: Alex 扮演面包店店员。他会先表示抱歉，并解释可能是理货员没注意到，询问你是要退款还是换一条新鲜的。
life_food_bakery_expired_bread.task: 向店员指出买到了过期发霉的面包，并要求更换新鲜吐司

tgt: Excuse me, do you know where we are supposed to put our trash when the dumpster is full?
The bins outside are completely packed right now.
Is there a specific day when the garbage truck comes?
traps: 说成 'Where should I throw my rubbish?' 动词搭配不够地道，扔垃圾一般用 'throw away my trash' 或 'put my garbage'。
说成 'The big bucket is full'。垃圾桶不用 bucket（那是水桶），大型垃圾桶的标准称呼是 'dumpster' 或 'garbage bin'。
询问垃圾车来的时候说成 'When does the garbage car come?' 垃圾车不叫 garbage car，应该叫 'garbage truck' 或 'trash truck'。
life_neigh_garbage_bin.ai: Alex 扮演热心邻居，会耐心地告诉你垃圾清运的时间或者另一个垃圾桶的位置。
life_neigh_garbage_bin.task: 向邻居咨询垃圾桶满后的处理办法

tgt: Five dollars plus for a standard coffee is becoming the new normal.
Are coffee bean import costs still climbing internationally?
It's hard for local spots to keep prices stable under this kind of pressure.
traps: use "Become normal now"，the new normal 是固定搭配，表示“已经成了新常态”。
use "Keep price not change"，保持价格稳定地道说法是 keep prices stable。
use "Import price"，进口成本应用 import costs 或 sourcing costs。
talk_money_auckland_coffee.ai: Alex 扮演咖啡店老板，笑着跟你解释说咖啡豆进口价和店铺租金连年上涨，小店只能微调价格来维持品质。
talk_money_auckland_coffee.task: 跟老板聊聊现在咖啡和日常餐饮价格上涨的趋势

tgt: That sounds lovely, Tom, but I've already made plans for Friday night that I can't really move.
I'm so sorry to miss out on your cooking this time, but how about a coffee next week instead?
I’d love to catch up properly once things settle down a bit.
traps: 说成'I have something to do'太模糊，像在敷衍；应说'I have a prior engagement'或'I have plans'.
说成'I cannot go'语气太生硬像命令；应说'I’m so sorry, but I won’t be able to make it'.
说成'Maybe next time'通常被认为是客套话；应具体化提议，如'Are you free next Tuesday?'
soc_decline_neighbor_dinner.ai: Tom，新邻居，性格开朗，希望能通过晚餐让你快速融入社区，对你的缺席会感到有一点点遗憾。
soc_decline_neighbor_dinner.task: 委婉拒绝晚餐邀请，并主动提出下周找个时间喝杯咖啡。

tgt: I'm sorry, but I don't sign up for any recurring donations at the door.
I'm not interested in this program, please take me off your list.
I have my own ways of supporting charities, so I'll pass.
traps: 说'I don't have money'，听起来像找借口且显得卑微，应用'I have my own ways of supporting charities'。
说'No signature'，语法不通，应完整表达为'I don't sign up for any recurring donations'。
说'Don't knock my door again'，语气太冲，礼貌拒绝是'Please take me off your list'。
life_no_door_charity.ai: Alex是募捐活动的志愿者，他的目标是争取社区居民签署每月30美金的捐赠协议，并认为你应该支持他们的公益活动。
life_no_door_charity.task: 坚定拒绝签字和自动扣款的要求，并把对方礼貌送走。

tgt: I'm currently at the meeting point and just received the cancellation email. This is very inconvenient.
Since this was a last-minute cancellation, can we reschedule for tomorrow morning at the same price?
If you can't reschedule, I would like to request a full refund immediately.
traps: 错误说“You make me waste time”容易引起反感。应说“This has caused a significant change to my plans”。
错误说“You must pay me back”像命令。应说“I would like to request a full refund”更礼貌。
错误说“I am very unhappy”显得只会抱怨。应强调“inconvenience”以换取补偿。
life_tour_tour_cancel.ai: Alex是导游公司的客服，通过电话沟通。他表示是因为突发天气原因取消，无法提供当天的补救。
life_tour_tour_cancel.task: 争取改期或获得全额赔偿

tgt: There is a live jazz band playing at Blue Note this Saturday night.
Are you up for catching the 8:30 show with me?
We can grab a drink and enjoy the music.
traps: 用了 'Do you want to listen to jazz'。听现场演出习惯用 'catch a show' 或 'listen to live music'。
用了 'drink alcohol'。去酒吧喝一杯地道说法是 'grab a drink'。
用了 'Are you willing to go'。willing 语气过于严肃沉重，约朋友应用 'Are you up for...'。
soc_invite_jazz_bar.ai: Alex 扮演 Ethan，他周末正好没事，对去听爵士乐表现出极大兴趣。
soc_invite_jazz_bar.task: 成功约到 Ethan 周六晚上 8 点半去爵士酒吧。

tgt: I bought this storage unit yesterday, but there are some missing parts.
The box is labeled K-92, but it contains the wrong panels inside.
Could you check if you have the right parts in stock for me?
traps: Avoid saying 'I want to change the goods.' Use 'exchange' for specific items. Say 'I'd like to exchange these parts.'
Avoid 'The box is wrong.' It's better to be specific: 'The parts inside don't match the instructions/model.'
Avoid 'Can you help me to solve this?' It's more natural to say 'Can you help me with this issue?'
talk_home_furniture_assembly_1364.ai: 客服中心的工作人员，态度友好，正准备帮你查询库存。
talk_home_furniture_assembly_1364.task: 向工作人员说明情况，并要求更换正确的板材。

tgt: The shell of this right boot is pressing really hard against my outer ankle, and it’s getting pretty painful.
Do you have a boot with a wider last in a 26.5 size that I could swap this for?
Could we also adjust the forward lean on the new boots while you're setting them up?
traps: 常说“This shoes are too tight.”，滑雪靴在英文里必须用复数名词“boots”且不能用“shoes”，否则显得极不专业，应用“These boots are...”。
常说“My foot hurts by the plastic.”，“by the plastic”是中式直译，表达被硬壳硌痛应用“pressed against the plastic shell”或“the plastic is biting into my ankle”。
常说“I want to change another one.”，“change another one”语法重复且口语化，地道说法应用“swap this for a different pair”或“exchange these for a wider fit”。
hob_ski_rental_mismatch.ai: Alex 扮演雪具租赁店的技术员。他刚接待完一个旅行团，正忙着给其他客人调雪板固定器（Binding），看到你一瘸一拐进来，微笑着询问有什么需要帮忙。
hob_ski_rental_mismatch.task: 向技术员说明右脚靴壳（Shell）压脚踝，要求更换大半码或换一款鞋楦（Last）更宽的 26.5 码雪靴。

tgt: Thanks for the heads-up! Do you really think using 92 instead of 95 would cause engine knocking in this model?
Is there a significant difference in performance or long-term wear if I stick to the lower grade?
Would it be safe to mix them, or should I find a station that carries the higher octane fuel?
traps: 说 'I don't care, it's just gas' 显得很不负责。应说 'I'm concerned about the potential damage'。
说 'You are sure?' 显得质问对方。应说 'Are you certain about the requirements for this specific engine?'。
说 'My car is old, it doesn't matter' 逻辑不对。应说 'Since it's an older vehicle, does it require higher octane?'。
hob_car_fuel_type.ai: 正在隔壁加油的当地老司机。他很肯定地说，如果不加高标号，引擎迟早会敲缸。
hob_car_fuel_type.task: 向老司机确认油品标准，并询问如果加了低标号油会有什么后果

tgt: Hey Sam, sorry for waking you up. I'm in the middle of making breakfast and realized I'm completely out of eggs. Could I borrow two eggs from you?
I'll definitely pick up a fresh carton and replace them for you when I go to the grocery store this afternoon.
Thanks, buddy, I owe you one.
traps: 说 'I have no eggs' 语法虽然没错，但表达数量用光更地道的是 'I am completely out of eggs'。
说 'I will buy new eggs to you' 是典型中式直译。英文应该用 'replace them for you' 或 'pay you back with a new carton'。
表达欠人情说成 'I owe you a favor' 略显严肃。日常生活中说 'I owe you one' 最为地道自然。
soc_borrow_recipe_ingredient.ai: Alex 扮演室友山姆。他刚被敲门声吵醒，睡眼惺忪地打开门，听到你是为了做早饭借鸡蛋，笑了笑表示没问题。
soc_borrow_recipe_ingredient.task: 向室友借两个鸡蛋应急，并答应下午补买还给他

tgt: I have a severe, life-threatening allergy to all tree nuts, so I need to make sure there's no cross-contamination.
Could you please check with the chef if the fries are cooked in peanut oil or vegetable oil?
If there's any chance this dish has touched nuts, I'll need to order something else.
traps: 常说 "I am poisonous to nuts"，这是致命错误，"poisonous" 是指你有毒会毒死别人，正确说法是 "I am allergic to nuts"。
常说 "My allergy is very big"，"big" 不能用来形容过敏严重，地道说法是 "I have a severe allergy" 或 "My allergy is severe"。
常说 "Please let the kitchen be careful"，太笼统了，地道表达针对交叉污染要说 "Please ensure there is no cross-contamination in the kitchen"。
life_eat_severe_nut_allergy.ai: Alex 扮演餐厅服务员。他会先介绍菜单，听到过敏后会认真记录并向你确认过敏的严重程度，同时解释厨房的操作流程。
life_eat_severe_nut_allergy.task: 向服务员明确指出过敏源，并要求厨房彻底排查交叉污染风险

tgt: Excuse me, would you mind if I shared the power outlet with you? My laptop is running low on battery.
I hate to be a bother, but I really need to get some urgent work done. Could we take turns using the plug?
I noticed you've been here for a while, would you be needing the outlet for much longer?
traps: 直接说“Move your laptop”极其粗鲁，应该用“Would you mind if...”开头。
说“I have to use this”显得理所当然，建议加上“I'm in a bit of a rush”说明原因。
“Give me the power plug”是不地道的祈使句，应用“Could I please use the outlet for a moment?”
life_emo_noisy_cafe.ai: 咖啡店顾客，正戴着耳机看剧，完全没意识到自己占用了唯一的充电位，被提醒后有点尴尬。
life_emo_noisy_cafe.task: 礼貌地沟通，委婉地提出能不能共享插座，或者请他让出插座。

tgt: I'm pretty sure the special effects cost about twelve dollars to make.
The pilot is probably watching this movie to learn how to land.
Is this an action film or a very slow comedy?
traps: 容易说成 'This movie is very old and bad.'，词汇贫乏且不像在聊天。
容易把特效说成 'special effect'（单数），习惯上这类老梗统称为复数 'special effects'。
容易用 'Do you think this movie is funny?'，变成了严肃提问，而不是抛出幽默的梗。
talk_joke_flight_movie.ai: Alex 扮演邻座乘客。他注意到你在看屏幕，也看了一眼那部老电影，想跟你搭话开个玩笑。
talk_joke_flight_movie.task: 用轻松的语气和邻座吐槽这部老电影的特效或剧情，开个玩笑。

tgt: I’m going away for a few days, do you have a pet sitter you trust?
Is there a place nearby that you would recommend for boarding?
How do you usually handle your pet when you go out of town?
traps: 说成 'Who takes your dog?'，语气太像审问，用 'Do you have a pet sitter you trust' 更自然。
说成 'Where to leave my dog?'，离开用 'leave' 但去处建议用 'boarding' 或 'pet sitter'。
说成 'Do you know a good shop?'，托管中心用 'boarding facility' 或 'daycare' 更精准。
talk_pet_pet_sitter.ai: 邻居，平时也养宠物。他推荐了附近一家口碑很好的宠物托管中心，并告诉你联系方式。
talk_pet_pet_sitter.task: 从邻居那里获取可靠的宠物托管建议

tgt: Thank you so much for looking after my cat while I was away; she looks so happy.
I picked up this set as a token of my gratitude; I hope you like the scent.
You’ve been a huge help, and I’m so lucky to have you as a roommate.
traps: 说成 'You worked hard for my cat'。逻辑不通；应该说 'Thank you for taking such good care of her'。
说成 'I pay you with this gift'。显得交易感极强；应该说 'This is just a little thank-you for your help'。
说成 'Don't be shy'。指责对方；应该说 'I really wanted to show my appreciation'。
life_gift_pet_sitter.ai: Alex 扮演室友，他很喜欢你的猫，觉得帮你照顾是举手之劳，不想让你觉得因为这件事产生负担。
life_gift_pet_sitter.task: 送出礼物，强调对他照看猫咪的谢意，并保持轻松的朋友氛围

tgt: There is a water leak by the window in room 1205.
Could you please arrange another room for me?
The carpet is getting wet, could you send someone to help?
traps: 说成 'My room is raining'，虽然能听懂但很滑稽，应改为 'There is a water leak in my room'。
说成 'I want to change room now'，语气太强硬，应使用 'Could I possibly move to a different room?'。
说成 'The room has a problem'，描述太模糊，应具体说 'The window is leaking water'。
life_wx_hotel_flood.ai: Alex 扮演前台服务员。他表示非常抱歉，会立即安排客房部处理并为你更换房间。
life_wx_hotel_flood.task: 描述漏水情况并要求换房

tgt: I'm currently Ascendant, mainly maining duelist agents.
Hit me up with a game invite if you have room for one more.
Are you guys playing on the NA Central server right now?
traps: 介绍自己玩什么英雄时说 'I playing duelist'，语法错误且不地道，应说 'maining duelist agents'。
让别人拉你进组说成 'invite me to your group'，网游里组队通常说 'give me a game invite' 或 'have room for one more'。
问服务器说成 'Which server are you using'，正确的设备和网络搭配是 'playing on the NA server'。
hob_video_discord_ping_pong.ai: Alex 是社区里的活跃网友，他看到你的消息，说他朋友刚下线，问你想打哪个服务器、段位在什么水平。
hob_video_discord_ping_pong.task: 告诉他你的段位是超凡（Ascendant），主玩决斗位，问他有没有空一起打

tgt: Could we possibly move to that quieter table by the window?
Is it okay if we sit over there instead? It's a bit noisy here.
We'd love a booth seat if one is available, please.
traps: 容易说成 'We want to change table.'。'Change table' 听起来像要换一张桌子搬走，换座位应用 'move to...'。
容易说成 'Here is too noisy, give me another place.'。语气像在抱怨，用 'Could we possibly move to...' 更礼貌。
容易说成 'I don't like this seat.'。过于直接表达个人喜好，用客观理由加请求更得体。
life_eat_seat_preference.ai: Alex 扮演领位服务员。他面带微笑地表示理解，并立刻带你们去了靠窗的空座。
life_eat_seat_preference.task: 礼貌地请领位员带你们换到一个更安静的靠窗座位

tgt: I’m deeply sorry; I accidentally got some paint on the page while sketching.
Is there any possibility of professional cleaning instead of paying the full price?
I’d like to make this right; what are my options?
traps: 不要说 'It is just a little paint'，显得不负责任，应先道歉：'I’m deeply sorry'。
不要说 'I don't want to pay'，应说 'Is there an alternative to paying the full price?'
不要说 'I didn't mean to'，太幼稚，应说 'It was an accidental damage'。
hob_draw_library_book_damage.ai: 管理员，严肃指出污损图书违反了借阅协议，要求你赔偿书本全额购买费用。
hob_draw_library_book_damage.task: 诚恳道歉，并询问是否能通过寻找专业清洁或按成本价维修来解决。

tgt: My suitcase didn't appear on the carousel after flight BA281.
It's a medium-sized black hard-shell suitcase with a distinct yellow luggage tag.
I'm staying at the Hilton near the station; could you please expedite the delivery?
traps: 常说 'My luggage is lost'，不如说 'My suitcase didn't come out' 更具体。
常说 'Please check for me quickly'，语气过于命令，建议用 'Could you please look into this?' 更礼貌。
常说 'Send it to my hotel'，地道说法应包含 'forward' 或 'deliver'，如 'Could you have it forwarded to my hotel?'
talk_story_lost_luggage.ai: Alex 是机场地勤，他想尽快结束工作，起初建议你明天再查，但会根据你的描述配合找行李。
talk_story_lost_luggage.task: 描述箱子外观并要求他立即在系统里核实，确保行李能送往你下榻的酒店。

tgt: I'm looking for a 9-month lease. Is that possible?
Does the monthly rent change if I sign for a shorter period?
Could you clarify the price difference for the 9-month term?
traps: 说成 'Can I rent for 9 months?'。虽然对，但 'lease' 更符合租房语境。
说成 'Is the price higher if I stay less time?'。用 'shorter period' 比 'less time' 更地道。
说成 'Why you increase the price?'。缺少助动词，应为 'Why are you increasing the price?'。
life_rent_discuss_lease_term.ai: Alex 是房东，他表示 9 个月可以，但月租金需要比 12 个月的合同贵 50 美元。
life_rent_discuss_lease_term.task: 协商租期并确认价格变化

tgt: Excuse me, could you tell me how to get to Blue Cafe on Oak Street?
Am I far from the central library? I think I'm lost.
Could you point me in the direction of the nearest subway station?
traps: 直接喊 'Where is Blue Cafe?' 语气显得有些生硬命令式，前面加 'Excuse me, do you know where...' 会礼貌得多。
说成 'I cannot find my way.'。虽然语法没错，但地道口语更常说 'I think I'm lost' 或 'I'm trying to find...'。
问方向时说 'Give me the direction.' 像是在下命令，地道说法是 'Could you point me in the direction of...?'。
life_way_street_lost.ai: Alex 扮演路过的当地居民。他正拿着一杯咖啡散步，会停下来帮你辨别方向。
life_way_street_lost.task: 向路人出示手写的地址，询问蓝莓咖啡馆怎么走

tgt: My throat has been feeling a bit hoarse after my singing practice.
Is there anything I can do to soothe my vocal cords?
Should I avoid singing completely for a few days?
traps: 说成 'My throat is dry'，嗓子哑应用 'hoarse' 而不是 'dry'。
说成 'How to make my voice better?'，太口语化，用 'soothe my vocal cords' 更准确。
说成 'Can I sing tomorrow?'，用 'Should I avoid...' 表达咨询建议更好。
hob_sing_vocal_health.ai: Alex是医生，他建议你多喝温水并休息几天，不要过度用嗓。
hob_sing_vocal_health.task: 说明原因并获取护理建议

tgt: Could you explain roughly how many thousands of years this mineralization process takes?
Is this kind of fossilization common in sedimentary rock formations?
How can scientists tell the difference between original bone and mineral replacements?
traps: 不要说 'how many years does it need'，询问过程持续时间用 'how many years this process takes'。
不要说 'hard rocks like stones'，地质学常识中岩层统称为 'sedimentary rock formations'（沉积岩层）。
不要说 'real bone and fake bone'，专业又通俗的说法是 'original bone and mineral replacements'。
talk_edu_museum_docent_q.ai: Alex 是博物馆的资深科普讲解员。他刚讲完关于古生物骨骼石化的部分，微笑著点名让你提问。
talk_edu_museum_docent_q.task: 用适合大龄儿童也能听懂的英语，向 Alex 询问这种矿物质替代过程在自然界通常需要持续多少年。

tgt: Wait, we only shuffled the terrain hexes, not the harbor tokens at the edge.
Look at the rulebook page 7, port rules remain unchanged unless specified.
Let us just finish this trade and check the rulebook for the next turn.
traps: 容易说成『We only change the land, not harbor.』，漏掉了复数和定冠词，地道说法应该用『We only shuffled the terrain hexes, not the harbor tokens.』
容易说成『According to the book page seven...』，缺少介词，地道说法是『Look at the rulebook page 7...』
容易说成『Let us finish this trade and see rule later.』，表达比较生硬，地道说法是『Let us just finish this trade and check the rulebook for the next turn.』
hob_chess_catan_harbor.ai: 山姆，你的桌游同伴。他认为你们开局前重新排列过板块，这个港口的兑换比例变了，希望你按修改后的规则重新出牌。
hob_chess_catan_harbor.task: 向山姆澄清并坚持按基础规则或者当前板块的实际标注来完成这次羊毛换砖头

tgt: I actually have to disagree with you on that one; I think the extra forty minutes add crucial depth to the world-building.
Sure, the runtime is nearly four hours, but every single added scene fleshes out the character motivations much better.
For fifteen bucks, getting the extended edition with all the behind-the-scenes footage is an absolute steal.
traps: 说‘我不同意你的看法’用 'I don't agree with you' 略显生硬直接。地道说法是 'I actually have to disagree with you on that one.'。
表达‘扩充世界观’说成 'make the world bigger'。地道说法是 'add crucial depth to the world-building.'。
说‘绝对划算’用 'It's very cheap'。地道说法是 'It's an absolute steal.'。
talk_movie_director_cut_debate.ai: Alex 扮演唱片店店员。他是个资深影迷，对电影剪辑有强烈的个人审美，喜欢跟顾客深度切磋，会用温和的语气阐述为什么加戏破坏了节奏。
talk_movie_director_cut_debate.task: 反驳 Alex 的观点，说出你为什么认为加长版扩充了世界观且非常值得购买。

tgt: Thank you so much for keeping my phone safe; I was so panicked!
You were so helpful, and I wanted to give you these cookies as a personal thank you.
I really appreciate your professionalism and kindness.
traps: 不要说'My phone was lost, you find it'，应说'You kept my phone safe for me'。
不要说'I give this because you work hard'，显得很轻视职业，应说'As a personal token of my appreciation'。
不要说'Thank you for your service'，在私人谈话里太官方，用'Thank you for your kindness'更好。
soc_thanks_lost_phone.ai: 酒店前台，服务意识强，觉得保管失物是职责所在。
soc_thanks_lost_phone.task: 赞美对方的负责，并以私人名义送出饼干。

tgt: The rapid expansion of the subway lines fundamentally reshaped the real estate geography of the outer boroughs.
Private transit operators were heavily incentivized by the surging commuter demand in Manhattan.
It’s incredible that the first underground stretch opened back in October 1904 without major engineering disasters.
traps: 把房地产投机说成 'buying and selling houses'。地道商旅/历史表述为 'real estate speculation' 或 'property development'。
误用 'The city needed trains so they built them'。地道说法是 'The infrastructural demands of a burgeoning metropolis outpaced surface transit.'。
用 'They spent too much money'。地道口语应用 'Capital allocation for subterranean tunneling posed severe financial hurdles back then.'。
talk_history_new_york_subway.ai: Alex 认为当年的私人私营铁路公司（IRT）完全是为了房地产投机才延伸地铁线路的，而你倾向于认为这是当时城市化爆炸性增长下的必然基础设施选择。
talk_history_new_york_subway.task: 用英语与 Alex 探讨20世纪初纽约地铁建设背后的城市化动力与资本运作

tgt: I accidentally picked up the strawberry flavor instead of plain.
Is it possible to exchange this for the plain version?
I haven't opened the package yet.
traps: 说成 'I bought wrong.' 语法不完整，应说 'I bought the wrong flavor.'
说成 'Can I change the flavor?' 语意模糊，应用 'exchange this for...' 表明交换动作。
说成 'I didn't open it.' 此时用现在完成时 'I haven't opened it' 更符合习惯。
life_food_wrong_flavor.ai: Alex 是收银台主管，他会查看小票，询问你是否开封，如果未开封会帮你操作换货。
life_food_wrong_flavor.task: 向主管说明拿错口味，询问是否可以更换。

tgt: Should I hold the paper cups by the rim or the bottom?
Do we need to yell out 'water' or 'sports drink' to the runners?
Let me grab another tray of water cups from the box.
traps: 说成 'Hold the cup like this?'。只用手势没有语言交流，应用 'Hold the cups by the rim'。
说成 'Need to shout?'。太简略，地道说法是 'Should we call out the drinks to runners?'。
说成 'I go to get more water.'。动作正在发生或即将发生，用 'Let me grab...' 更自然。
hob_volunteer_marathon_water.ai: Alex 是补给站的队长，负责协调水杯的补充和分发节奏。他提醒大家注意递水时不要砸到选手。
hob_volunteer_marathon_water.task: 和队长确认递水的手势和分工

tgt: No thanks, I prefer taking pictures by myself.
I'm all set with my phone camera, thanks.
Appreciate the offer, but I'm good.
traps: 说 'You are not a professional' 会引发不必要的争吵，拒绝拍照说 'No, thank you, I don't need a photographer.'
回答 'I have no camera' 逻辑混乱（因为你在用手机），地道说法是 'I'm happy with my own snapshots.'
说 'Keep away from me' 反应过度，正常拒绝说 'I'm fine, thanks for asking.'
life_no_park_photographer.ai: Alex 扮演自由摄影师，他指了指自己的相机屏幕，展示之前的作品，极力劝说你试拍一张。
life_no_park_photographer.task: 明确告诉对方不需要拍照，并结束对话

tgt: Could you show me the exact thickness you are looking for?
I'll make sure to chop the rest of the batch much finer.
Does this size look better for the soup base?
traps: 说成 'Please show me how to cut.' 太过生硬，地道说法应用 'Could you show me the exact thickness you are looking for?'
说成 'I will cut smaller.' 词汇单一，地道说法应用 'I will make sure to chop the rest of the batch much finer.'
说成 'Is this big ok?' 语法不对，地道说法应用 'Does this size look better for the soup base?'
hob_volunteer_community_kitchen.ai: Alex 是厨房主管，他会友善地示范并要求你把洋葱切得更薄，同时解释这样煮出来的汤底口感才对。
hob_volunteer_community_kitchen.task: 向主管确认具体的尺寸要求，并重新调整切菜手法

tgt: I'm planning to make a peach cobbler today, so I'm looking for ones that are a bit riper.
These are a bit firm for my recipe, do you have any that are softer and sweeter?
Could you help me pick a few that are ready to use right away?
traps: Don't say 'I want to cook cake', say 'I'm baking a peach cobbler' as 'baking' is specific for desserts.
Avoid 'Are these good?', say 'Are these ripe enough for baking?' to be specific.
Don't say 'Give me the soft ones', say 'Could you help me pick out the softer ones?' to be more polite.
talk_food_farmer_market.ai: 摊主，非常了解自家产品。他极力推荐一种较硬的品种，但你坚持要选软的，两人对“熟度”有不同审美。
talk_food_farmer_market.task: 说服摊主帮你挑出几个最适合做烘焙的、熟度正好的桃子

tgt: Can this old mechanical clock be fixed?
Roughly how much would the repair cost?
How many days will it take to get it ready?
traps: 问能不能修好说 'Can you repair this clock? It is broken.' 表达太绝对，地道说法是 'Is this movement salvageable?' 或 'Can this old clock be repaired?'。
问大概多少钱说 'How much money for fixing?'。中式语法，地道询价是 'Roughly how much would a service cost?'。
问要几天说 'How many days do you need?'。听起来像在催工，地道句型是 'How long does a typical overhaul take?'。
hob_collect_vintage_clock_repair_quote.ai: Alex 扮演老钟表匠，戴着放大镜，接过闹钟简单看了一眼齿轮，准备给你报价。
hob_collect_vintage_clock_repair_quote.task: 弄清楚修理费用和大概需要几天

tgt: That's terrible, especially on a new sofa.
It’s hard to blame the kid when the parent doesn't even try to stop them.
I really feel for you; having to deal with that is tough.
traps: 说成 'The mother is not good.'，太简单。应说 'The mother wasn't supervising him at all'。
说成 'It is very pity for the chair.'，语法错误。应该说 'It’s a shame about the chair'。
说成 'You must be very angry.'，不礼貌的猜测。应说 'That must have been really frustrating for you'。
soc_gossip_dentist_wait.ai: Alex是诊所前台，他负责维护环境和器材，他对家长失职导致家具受损很生气。
soc_gossip_dentist_wait.task: 回应Alex，表示对公共场合监管不力的家长感到无奈。

tgt: I can't believe anyone would leave a place in that condition.
Leaving trash behind for others to clean up is just awful.
The landlord definitely deserved to keep their security deposit.
traps: 使用 'The tenant has no social morality'，词汇过于书面和宏大。地道吐槽是 'That tenant was absolute trash' 或 'had no respect for the property'。
使用 'It's very difficult for the landlord to clean'，词义偏弱。地道说法是 'The landlord must have had a nightmare cleaning that up'。
使用 'People should behave better when they rent'，听起来像在发社论。地道说法是 'Basic decency is too much to ask for, I guess'。
soc_gossip_moving_elevator.ai: Alex是同楼栋的热心住户，见证了那场糟糕的退房闹剧，正愤愤不平地向你倒苦水。
soc_gossip_moving_elevator.task: 顺着对方的话表达对这种糟糕行为的震惊和谴责。

tgt: Thanks for the pour, but I don't drink alcohol and I'll pass on the event.
I'm actually in a bit of a rush today, so I can't sign up for anything.
Please don't put me down on the list. I'm definitely not coming.
traps: 使用 'I cannot drink your wine'，听起来像是在指控酒有问题，地道表达应用 'I don't drink alcohol' 或 'I'll pass on the wine'。
使用 'Do not write my email'，命令语气太强且搭配生硬，地道表达应用 'Please don't put me down on the list' 或 'I'd rather not leave my email'。
使用 'I have no interesting in this'，存在语法错误（interesting应为interested），地道表达应用 'I'm not interested in attending'。
life_no_wine_tasting.ai: Alex 扮演热情的红酒推销员。他会强调品酒会有稀有酒款和免费点心，并试图留下你的邮箱。
life_no_wine_tasting.task: 婉拒试喝并拒绝参加品酒会，坚决不留个人信息。

tgt: I understand the system is down, but I have vital medication in my checked luggage that I need to take tonight.
Is there any way to prioritize locating my specific bag, or can the airline assist me in obtaining a replacement prescription?
Could you provide me with a claim reference number so I can track the status once the system is back up?
traps: 说成 'I need my pills'，太随意，应用 'I have essential medication'。
说成 'You must help me now'，这是在给对方压力，应说 'Could you please assist me as this is a medical emergency?'
说成 'Where is my bag? I want it'，这是质问，应改为 'Could you please check the status of my baggage?'
life_wx_missing_baggage.ai: Alex是行李查询柜台的工作人员，他只能查到系统状态显示“延误”，无法给出具体的到达时间。
life_wx_missing_baggage.task: 让Alex意识到问题的严重性，协助联系药店或提供紧急医疗协助。

tgt: I am so sorry for the disturbance. We'll keep it down.
Thank you for letting me know. We will be much quieter.
I apologize if we were bothering you.
traps: 避免说 'We will be quiet'，语气太强，应说 'We will keep the noise down'。
避免说 'I will tell them to shut up'，shut up 很粗鲁，应说 'I'll ask everyone to speak more softly'。
避免说 'Sorry for your bothering'，应说 'Sorry for bothering you'。
soc_sorry_neighbor_party.ai: Alex 是你的邻居，他态度和善，只是希望晚上十点后能保持安静。
soc_sorry_neighbor_party.task: 向邻居道歉，并承诺会控制音量。

tgt: I am currently traveling and this is causing me a lot of trouble.
Is there any way to expedite the review process?
What specific documentation can I provide to speed this up?
traps: 说成 'You locked my money'，语带怨气，应使用 'My account has been restricted'。
说成 'This is stupid'，不要评价流程，应使用 'This is causing me significant inconvenience'。
说成 'I need it now'，太强势，应使用 'Is there any possibility to expedite'。
soc_bad_bank_frozen.ai: 你是银行客服。你核实了身份，告知由于安全风控政策，账户必须经过人工审核才能解冻，需要24小时。
soc_bad_bank_frozen.task: 强调你现在正急需资金，询问有无任何加急处理的可能性。

tgt: The scratch on the floor was already there when I moved in, as noted in the move-in checklist.
I’d like to request a full refund of my $3,000 security deposit as the apartment was returned in the same condition.
Could you please review the photos I took during the initial walk-through?
traps: 不要说 'You should return my money to me'，这听起来像是在命令对方，用 'I would like to request...' 更礼貌。
不要说 'It is not my damage'，这是中式英语，地道说法是 'This damage was pre-existing'。
